questions.question: When Moses told the Israelites all the LORD's words and laws, what did they all answer together?

answers.text: We will do all the words
We will weigh all the words
We will discuss all the words

questions.question: After the Israelites promised to obey the LORD, what did Moses do with the blood in the bowls?

answers.text: He splattered it on the people
He carried it up the mountain
He set it before the elders
